purpose: Selected Living Mud Patch visual exploration; not shipped gameplay assets

concepts.name: 04-living-mud-patch-active
concepts.prompt: Edit reference image 1 into a refined, genuinely usable mobile GAMEPLAY mockup of the selected Living Mud Patch direction. Reference 1 is the edit target and composition reference. Reference 2 is the canonical Rosie character identity, reference 3 canonical Great Hungerer identity. Preserve reference1's organic muddy oval, curved brushed-cleared swathe, woodland softness, warm cream paper and rose button. Match characters to references2/3: round big-eyed ink-outlined Rosie, chubby crowned bib-wearing Hungerer. Refine by REMOVING ALL superfluous signboards, decorative slogans, motivational phrases, written explanations, heart doodles and extra labels. Do not replace them with more writing. Reduce background clutter and leaf detail, use authored broad shapes and clear ink silhouettes matching the source character art. Hungerer should be smaller in background, about 15% screen height, so brushable mud takes at least 65% of screen. The only text permitted anywhere is title "Truffle Patch", one short instruction "Brush the mud away", tiny pouch label "3 finds", and bottom button "Pack up". No phone bezel, logos or extra HUD. Show one curving swipe already brushed through a continuous organic mud field revealing a golden truffle cluster, part of a mysterious relic and a little glimmer, with thick tactile crumbs displaced along the swipe. Rosie peeks at lower left without occluding play. Collection pouch lower right. Preserve cozy clear 2D game illustration; avoid photographic soil texture. Large safe-area back affordance and bottom button. High fidelity portrait 9:16 game concept. It must look like a sparse interactive game, not an illustrated poster.

concepts.name: 05-living-mud-patch-complete
concepts.prompt: Edit reference1 into the COMPLETED companion screen for Living Mud Patch. Reference2 locks canonical Rosie's round big-eyed face and clean ink contours; reference3 locks crowned bib-wearing Hungerer. It is the end of a dig, all rewards have already been banked. Maintain the same woodland setting and organic oval mud patch, but the brushing interaction is finished and de-emphasized: flattened freshly disturbed earth in mid-background, no glowing touch targets or invitation to resume. In foreground a small OPEN cloth pouch holding three golden truffles on a warm cream paper receipt, with Rosie beside it looking content. Use warm broad drawn shapes rather than photographic texture; simplify background detail. Keep the receipt compact so the place still feels like a woodland. Text permitted ONLY: title "Finds packed", short line "Yours to keep", pouch label "3 finds", and one calm rose-paper button "Back to Barn". Do not show any "Dig again", replay, countdown, next-feeding banner, locked button, nag, ads, bonus claims, unexplained extra rewards, motivational slogan or signboard. No phone bezel. The design clearly finishes the moment; the player takes the earned finds home and the dig invitation is absent there until their next Feeding. Portrait 9:16 polished mobile game mockup. Same visual world as reference1, sparse authored composition, readable type, generous touch targets.
